about: How a note's typed 'Attach to task' name finds its task. Each case adds `tasks` to a fresh app in order, types `typed` into the field and presses Save. `attachesTo` is the index into `tasks` of the task the note must attach to; null means the Save must be refused. task-mosaic-app's native test and the web host's test both run every case, so the two hosts cannot drift apart. Invisible characters are written as \u escapes.
